story: An icon of the skies, the Crested Serpent Eagle (Spilornis cheela) is a species from the Accipitridae family. It thrives in Forest edges; dry/wet forests; tea plantations; wooded savannas; mangroves; and gardens, where it interacts with its environment in unique ways. With a conservation status of Least Concern (LC), the Crested Serpent Eagle is a focus for conservationists worldwide. Understanding the needs of the Crested Serpent Eagle helps us better comprehend the challenges facing our planet's wildlife. This poster is a celebration of the Crested Serpent Eagle, a bird that inspires wonder and highlights the critical importance of conservation efforts.
